subject: Mathematics
title: Vector Algebra
summary: Vectors have magnitude and direction; a = a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂. They add by the triangle/parallelogram law, and any vector can be written in terms of three non-coplanar vectors.
The dot product a · b = |a||b| cos θ gives angles, projections and perpendicularity. The cross product a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂ gives areas and a vector perpendicular to both.
The scalar triple product [a b c] gives the volume of a parallelepiped and tests coplanarity; the vector triple product expands as a × (b × c) = (a · c)b − (a · b)c.

formulas.name: Section formula (vectors)
formulas.formula: internal m:n → (mb + na)/(m + n);  midpoint (a + b)/2

formulas.name: Dot product
formulas.formula: a · b = |a||b| cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃;  a ⊥ b ⇔ a · b = 0

formulas.name: Projection
formulas.formula: projection of a on b = (a · b)/|b|;  vector projection = ((a · b)/|b|²) b
formulas.when: Component of one vector along another.

formulas.name: Cross product
formulas.formula: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂ = determinant |î ĵ k̂; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃|;  a × b = −b × a;  a ∥ b ⇔ a × b = 0

formulas.name: Areas
formulas.formula: parallelogram with sides a, b: |a × b|;  with diagonals d₁, d₂: ½|d₁ × d₂|;  triangle: ½|a × b|

formulas.name: Scalar triple product
formulas.formula: [a b c] = a · (b × c) = determinant of components;  volume of parallelepiped = |[a b c]|;  tetrahedron = |[a b c]|/6

formulas.name: Coplanarity
formulas.formula: a, b, c coplanar ⇔ [a b c] = 0
formulas.when: Testing whether vectors lie in a plane.

formulas.name: Vector triple product
formulas.note: a × (b × c) ≠ (a × b) × c in general.

formulas.name: Properties of [a b c]
formulas.formula: [a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b] = −[b a c];  [a a b] = 0;  [a × b  b × c  c × a] = [a b c]²

formulas.name: Collinearity
formulas.formula: points A, B, C collinear ⇔ AB = λ AC (or AB × AC = 0)

examples.title: Dot product and angle
examples.problem: a = î + 2ĵ + 2k̂, b = 2î − ĵ + 2k̂. Find a · b and the angle between them.

examples.title: Projection
examples.problem: Projection of a on b for the vectors above?

examples.title: Area of parallelogram
examples.problem: Area of the parallelogram with sides a and b above?

examples.title: Volume
examples.problem: Volume of the parallelepiped with edges î, 2ĵ and î + ĵ + 3k̂?

examples.title: Coplanarity
examples.solution: Determinant = 0 ⇒ yes, coplanar (the third is 2 × second − first).

examples.title: Perpendicular unit vector
examples.problem: Unit vector perpendicular to both î + ĵ and ĵ + k̂?
examples.solution: (î + ĵ) × (ĵ + k̂) = î − ĵ + k̂; divide by √3 ⇒ ±(î − ĵ + k̂)/√3.

topics.title: Types of vectors
topics.explain: Zero vector, unit vector, equal vectors, collinear (parallel) vectors, coinitial vectors, coplanar vectors, position vector OP of a point P.

topics.title: Linear combinations
topics.explain: Two non-collinear vectors span a plane; three non-coplanar vectors span space. Vectors are linearly dependent if one is a combination of the others.

topics.title: Angle bisectors with vectors
topics.explain: The internal bisector of the angle between a and b is along â + b̂; the external bisector along â − b̂.

topics.title: Work and moment
topics.explain: Work done by force F through displacement d is F · d. Moment (torque) of F about a point is r × F.

topics.title: Direction cosines with vectors
topics.explain: For r = xî + yĵ + zk̂, the direction cosines are x/|r|, y/|r|, z/|r|. A unit vector making equal angles with the axes is (î + ĵ + k̂)/√3.

topics.title: Common mistakes
topics.explain: Dot product gives a scalar, cross product a vector. a · b = a · c does not imply b = c. Cross product is not associative and not commutative.

ratta: a · b = |a||b| cos θ;  ⊥ ⇔ a · b = 0.
|a × b| = area of parallelogram;  ½ for triangle.
